_comment: Hand-authored overlay for KIAD, merged over the surface geometry.
Ramp areas, frequencies and the taxilane grouping are transcribed from the published
IAD ramp chart. Ownership runs down the taxilane, not around a concourse: the North
Area Ramp works taxilanes A and B, so it owns the north face of the B/A concourse and
the Main Terminal Z gates, while the south face of the same building sits on taxilane C
and belongs to the Midfield Area Ramp. scripts/build-ramp-kiad.mjs assigns each gate its
ramp directly; the concourse lists here are the fallback for an OSM-built surface, which
Gate inventory is transcribed from the chart. Airline blocks remain UNVERIFIED.

ramps.label: North Area Ramp
ramps._owns: Main Terminal Z gates + north face of B and A

ramps.label: Midfield Area Ramp
ramps._owns: south face of B and A + north face of D and C
ramps.note: All pushback operations from the Midfield Terminal ramp that will enter taxilanes require clearance from ramp control.

ramps.label: South Area Ramp
ramps._owns: south face of D and C + the R Ramp hardstands

UAL._note: hub carrier — the midfield C/D building

_sources: Published IAD ramp chart — ramp areas, frequencies, taxilane grouping and gate inventory
Public IAD terminal guides — airline to concourse mapping (unverified)
_confirm: Airline blocks are compiled from public terminal guides and are unverified.
Face-level ramp ownership is inferred from the chart's taxilane grouping (A&B north, C&D
midfield, E&F south). Confirm that the boundary really runs down the alley.
The R Ramp hardstands are marked remote and are never drawn for a normal arrival; assign
them by hand when the gates are full.
sidSides is empty on purpose — set IAD SIDs from the SID Sides panel as they appear.
Concourse E opens in 2026 and is not modelled.
_procedures: Calling for the push: give call sign, terminal and gate, and first departure fix — "XYZ 898, A6D, Blues".
Pilots leaving the North Ramp and South Ramp areas should give their exit spot on initial contact with Ground.
Wingspan over 118 ft (36 m) is restricted from Taxilane A between A1 and A5.
Taxilane E1 is closed to aircraft with a wingspan over 118 ft (36 m).
